failure_policy: Persist every completed validation checkpoint, selected weights, negatives and stopping reason; stop after this one v2 attempt.
inference: Raw character token IDs only; no arithmetic features, answer lookup, constraints, or solver.
old_mod10_diagnostic: Unsupported cross-modulus vocabulary/task; do not map old answers or compare accuracy.

partition.historical_scope: A different modulus, symbol representation and learned weights; low operand sums may numerically coincide with old modulo10 labels. Not a claim that every mathematical fact is historically unseen.
partition.rule: Hash-sort55 unordered distinct pairs; first15 and reversals test30, next5 and reversals validation10, remaining35 and reversals plus11 diagonals train81.

task: Addition modulo11 with one-symbol operands/answer A..K representing0..10.
test_evaluation_policy: Generate labeled test rows and evaluate once only after restoring the validation-selected snapshot.

training.decay_equation: parameter.data *= 1 - learning_rate * weight_decay after Adam step
training.loss: Answer-only cross-entropy, final prompt position3 of four-character prompt a+b=.
training.optimizer: P43 Adam followed by decoupled multiplicative decay on every named parameter
training.selection: Minimum validation answer cross-entropy; strict improvement, ties earlier step; one trajectory, no test-selected retries.
